nodes.statement: ITU's 2025 report separates network availability from meaningful use, identifying affordability, devices, skills, quality and safety as persistent barriers.

provenance.source_title: ITU Global Connectivity Report 2025
provenance.source_scope: Global; meaningful connectivity dimensions and usage
provenance.source_limitation: Aggregates mask local barriers; report is not a causal experiment
provenance.boundary: Global aggregate and framework; not a local causal diagnosis.

nodes.statement: A systematic integrative review identifies literacy, affordability, accessible content and infrastructure as distinct dimensions of digital inequity.

provenance.source_title: Dimensions and barriers for digital (in)equity and digital divide: a systematic integrative review
provenance.source_scope: Review of developed-country literature
provenance.source_limitation: Dominated by European and North American studies; not globally representative
provenance.boundary: Review concentrated on developed-country studies.

nodes.statement: ITU DataHub provides connectivity indicators for country and regional comparison.

provenance.source_title: ITU DataHub
provenance.source_scope: Country and regional connectivity indicators
provenance.source_limitation: Monitoring platform, not an intervention or proof of improved access
provenance.boundary: Dataset availability is not a deployed inclusion intervention.

nodes.statement: WMO's 2025 water assessment documents abnormal river flows, declining land-water storage and continuing gaps in hydrological observations.

provenance.source_title: State of Global Water Resources 2025
provenance.source_scope: Global hydrological synthesis for 2025
provenance.source_limitation: Models and observations vary by region; gaps in affected areas
provenance.boundary: Hydrological model and station coverage differ across regions.

nodes.statement: WMO HydroSOS documents an initiative for hydrological status, outlooks and national capacity building.

provenance.source_title: HydroSOS — Hydrological Status and Outlook System
provenance.source_scope: Hydrological status/outlook and capacity-building initiative
provenance.source_limitation: Documentation does not verify local operational coverage or forecast skill
provenance.boundary: Do not infer operational reach or forecasting accuracy in any locality.

nodes.statement: IEA reports that approximately 730 million people lack electricity access, while many institutions with connections still face unreliable modern energy services.

provenance.source_title: Accelerating Clean Cooking and Electricity Services Scenario (ACCESS)
provenance.source_scope: Global access estimates and scenario modelling
provenance.source_limitation: Scenario projections are not proof of implemented electricity services
provenance.boundary: Global estimates, not local service quality measurements.

nodes.statement: IEA's ACCESS scenario models possible country-specific routes toward modern electricity and clean-cooking services.

provenance.source_title: Accelerating Clean Cooking and Electricity Services Scenario (ACCESS)
provenance.source_scope: Global access estimates and scenario modelling
provenance.source_limitation: Scenario projections are not proof of implemented electricity services
provenance.boundary: Scenario is modelling, not a deployed access program or measured effectiveness.

nodes.statement: WHO and the World Bank track essential health-service coverage separately from financial hardship due to out-of-pocket spending.

provenance.source_title: Tracking Universal Health Coverage: 2025 Global Monitoring Report
provenance.source_scope: Global health service coverage and financial hardship time series
provenance.source_limitation: Revised indicators; different observation years; not an impact evaluation
provenance.boundary: Service coverage is observed through 2023 and hardship through 2022; revised indicators.

nodes.statement: WHO provides a UHC monitoring portal with service-coverage and financial-protection indicators.

provenance.source_title: Monitoring Universal Health Coverage
provenance.source_scope: UHC data and indicators
provenance.source_limitation: Monitoring capacity, not direct service delivery
provenance.boundary: Data portal does not itself deliver health services.

nodes.statement: The 2025 FAO-led SOFI assessment links food-price inflation with reduced purchasing power and access to healthy diets.

provenance.source_title: The State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World 2025
provenance.source_scope: Global food security, food price inflation and healthy-diet affordability
provenance.source_limitation: Global analyses do not establish individual household mechanisms
provenance.boundary: Aggregate associations do not determine a given household's nutritional outcomes.

nodes.statement: UN-Habitat's 2026 housing report documents affordability pressures alongside informality, displacement, climate risk and adequacy concerns.

provenance.source_title: World Cities Report 2026: The Global Housing Crisis
provenance.source_scope: Global housing adequacy, affordability, informality and displacement
provenance.source_limitation: Heterogeneous definitions and estimates; not locality-specific
provenance.boundary: Global framing; measurement and definitions differ across cities.

nodes.statement: OECD's Affordable Housing Database publishes cross-national indicators of costs, housing conditions and housing policies.

provenance.source_title: OECD Affordable Housing Database
provenance.source_scope: OECD, EU and key partner housing indicators
provenance.source_limitation: Not globally representative; indicators have comparability caveats
provenance.boundary: Primarily OECD/EU/key partners; monitoring is not proof of improved affordability.

nodes.statement: The WHO/UNICEF 2025 JMP report estimates that 2.1 billion people lacked safely managed drinking water in 2024, with substantial inequality.

provenance.source_title: Progress on household drinking-water, sanitation and hygiene 2000–2024
provenance.source_scope: Household WASH trends and inequality estimates
provenance.source_limitation: Modelled/interpolated series; incomplete country coverage for some indicators
provenance.boundary: Modelled estimates with uneven country and indicator coverage.

nodes.statement: The WHO/UNICEF JMP data service publishes water, sanitation and hygiene monitoring indicators.

provenance.source_title: JMP WASH Data
provenance.source_scope: Country WASH indicators and metadata
provenance.source_limitation: Data portal is not a water supply intervention
provenance.boundary: Dataset is not an implemented water-supply service.

nodes.statement: IEA's grid stocktake describes transmission and interconnection bottlenecks as potential constraints on expanding electricity supply and renewable integration.

provenance.source_title: Electricity Grids and Secure Energy Transitions
provenance.source_scope: Global grid stocktake and bottleneck risks
provenance.source_limitation: Scenario and cross-market synthesis; not a local outage diagnosis
provenance.boundary: Global stocktake and scenarios; no individual grid verified.

nodes.statement: A 2025 technical review surveys grid-enhancing technologies including dynamic line ratings, power-flow controls and topology optimization.

provenance.source_title: Grid-enhancing technologies for clean energy systems
provenance.source_scope: Technical review of transmission grid-enhancing methods
provenance.source_limitation: Review discusses possibilities and adoption constraints; no universal deployment efficacy
provenance.boundary: Review of methods and deployment barriers; not independent proof of system-wide gains.

nodes.statement: A systematic review identifies crop diversification, climate-resilient varieties and precision tools as adaptation approaches with uneven evidence on system-level and equity outcomes.

provenance.source_title: Climate-Resilient Agri-Food Systems: A Review of Approaches and Outcomes
provenance.source_scope: Systematic review of adaptation approaches
provenance.source_limitation: Systemic links and equity effects often incompletely evaluated
provenance.boundary: Review synthesis; no specific location's intervention evaluated here.

nodes.statement: UNESCO's 2026 SDG 4 monitoring separates school participation from learning proficiency; its global primary reading-proficiency estimate has not been updated since COVID-19.

provenance.source_title: Monitoring education in the SDGs, GEM 2026
provenance.source_scope: Global education monitoring and learning proficiency
provenance.source_limitation: Learning estimates have limited recency and population coverage
provenance.boundary: Learning assessment coverage and timeliness are limited.

nodes.statement: World Bank Country Learning Poverty Briefs combine schooling and reading-proficiency indicators for country comparisons.

provenance.source_title: Country Learning Poverty Briefs
provenance.source_scope: Country-level learning-poverty estimates
